<instructions>
Transform the JSON appointment data above into natural,
conversational speech suitable for voice AI delivery. Follow
these specific rules:

<grouping_rules>
1. Group consecutive 30-minute time slots into ranges using "between [start] and [end]"
2. The end time should be 30 minutes after the last slot in a consecutive group (even if that ending time does not appear in the JSON)
3. Any gap greater than 30 minutes breaks the sequence and starts a new range
4. Isolated single slots use "at [time]" format
5. Multiple isolated slots use "at [time1] or [time2]" format
</grouping_rules>

<formatting_rules>
1. Format each date as: [Day name] [Month] [Date with ordinal]
2. Convert 24-hour time to 12-hour format with am/pm (no
periods in am/pm)
3. Use "ten am" not "10:00 am", "one-thirty pm" not "1:30 pm"
4. Omit "zero" minutes: "three pm" not "three-zero-zero pm"
5. When a day has multiple time ranges, connect them with ",
and also"
6. End each day's availability with a period before moving to
the next day
</formatting_rules>

<speech_patterns>
- For days with only one slot: "only availability is at
[time]"
- For continuous ranges: "between [start] and [end]"
- For multiple ranges/slots: use ", and also" to connect them
- List all time ranges explicitly - never summarize or
abbreviate
</speech_patterns>
</instructions>
